docs.title: Core Mod Entry and Registration System (modules/core)
docs.text:
lib.kasuga and lib.kasuga.registration in modules/core provide the mod bootstrap entry point, hierarchical declarative registration trees (Reg / RegistryGroup / Registry), stage-based event dispatching, and fluent registrars for Minecraft and KasugaLib registries.

  • Dependency injection bootstrap and @BeanOnlyIn: Inject Dependency Injection and Environment Wiring
  • Lifecycle phase boundaries and sidedness rules: Lifecycle and Initialization Order, Sidedness Model
  • Unified resource platform and VFS: Unified Resource Platform and Script Tickets, Virtual file systems
  • Core runtime subsystems (RPC, Saved, Compat, Rendering, Content): Core Runtime Infrastructure and Content Subsystems

docs.title: 1. Mod Entry, Application Context, and Startup Event (lib.kasuga)
docs.text:
Type / Method Responsibility and Signature KasugaLib @Mod("kasuga_lib") main mod class; exposes public static final String MODID = "kasuga_lib" and public static final ApplicationContext context = ModApplicationContext.create(KasugaLib.class). Its constructor calls ModApplicationContext.init(context, modEventBus, modContainer) and posts KasugaLibStartupEvent on ModLoader KasugaLib.getContext() Returns KasugaLib's shared Micronaut ApplicationContext KasugaLib.getBean(Class<T> beanType) Looks up a bean; throws IllegalStateException if !context.isRunning() KasugaLib.afterRunning(IEventBus eventBus, Runnable hook) Runs hook immediately if isRunning(), otherwise subscribes to KasugaLibStartupEvent on eventBus KasugaLib.isRunning() Returns context.isRunning() KasugaLibStartupEvent extends Event implements IModBusEvent, fired on the mod event bus after Micronaut context initialization KasugaLibApplication @Context singleton holding public static final Registry REGISTRY = KasugaLibRegistry.getRegistryOf(KasugaLib.MODID); calls REGISTRY.register(modEventBus) in @PostConstruct init() KasugaLibClientApplication @Context, @BeanOnlyIn.Client; calls KasugaLibApplication.REGISTRY.registerClient(modEventBus) in @PostConstruct init() KasugaLibRegistry public static Registry getRegistryOf(String modId) returning new Registry(modId)

External mods can create their own Registry via KasugaLibRegistry.getRegistryOf("your_modid") and invoke registry.register(modEventBus) (plus registry.registerClient(modEventBus) on the client).

docs.title: 2. Registration Tree Architecture (lib.kasuga.registration)
docs.text: Registration entries form a tree rooted at a Registry, sharing namespaces, creative tabs, and conditional dispatch rules through ancestor-first modifier transformation.

docs.title: 2.1 Reg<S extends Reg<?, ?>, T>
docs.text:
public abstract class Reg<S extends Reg<?, ?>, T> implements TransformerProvider, EntrySupplier<T>

Capability Signatures Behavior Tree wiring setParent(Reg<?, ?> parent), addChild(Reg<?, ?> child), getParentReg(), getChildren() Maintains bidirectional parent/child links (children uses ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet()) Fluent helpers S self(), S consumeBy(Consumer<S> targetRegistration) Preserves concrete subtype S across chained calls Modifier channel S configure(Modifier<?> modifier), S configure(Consumer<? super S> consumer) Registers ordered modifiers or configuration callbacks Transform evaluation <L> L transform(ModifierType<L> modifierType, L element) Walks parent.transform(...) first, then applies local modifiers; skips this when origin == this && modifierType.skipSelf (used for SCOPE) Class-keyed properties <P> S withProperty(Class<P> type, Function<P, P> modifier), <P> P applyProperties(Class<P> type, P value) Codegen-free property chain; also evaluates ancestor functions before local functions Stage dispatch void register(RegisterContext<?> context), void dispatchRegister(RegisterContext<?> context) Invokes register(context) on self, then recursively dispatches to children

docs.title: 2.2 RegistryGroup and Registry
docs.text:
• RegistryGroup (extends Reg<RegistryGroup, Void> implements Consumer<Reg<?, ?>>, IModifierConfigure<RegistryGroup>):
  • accept(Reg<?, ?> reg): sets reg.setParent(this).
  • dispatchWhen(BooleanSupplier predicate) / isDispatchEnabled(): overrides dispatchRegister to skip the group and its entire subtree whenever predicate.getAsBoolean() is false.
  • transform(Function<Reg<?, ?>, Reg<?, ?>> function): appends to transformation.
  • Registry (public final class Registry extends RegistryGroup):
  • Automatically configures ResourceLocationModifiers.withNamespace(modId) in its constructor.
  • getModId() returns the mod ID.
  • register(IEventBus modEventBus) and @OnlyIn(Dist.CLIENT) registerClient(IEventBus modEventBus) defer binding via KasugaLib.afterRunning(modEventBus, ...) into RegisterContextRegistry.configure(Side.COMMON / Side.CLIENT, this, modEventBus).
  • Per-registry attachments (backed by ConcurrentHashMap): getOrCreateAttachment(Class<T>, Supplier<? extends T>), getAttachment(Class<T>), setAttachment(Class<T>, T), removeAttachment(Class<?>).
  • CompositeReg<S extends CompositeReg<?>>: composite registration base whose getEntry() returns Map<Class<? extends Registry>, Registry> (must be overridden by codegen subclasses; otherwise throws IllegalStateException).

docs.title: 2.3 Core Helpers (lib.kasuga.registration.core)
docs.text: Type Key Members Description RegisterContext<L> onStage(RegistrationStage<T> stage, Consumer<T> consumer), getStage() Narrows an event context safely to the matching RegistrationStage RegisterContextRegistry Side.{COMMON, CLIENT}, configure(...), register(...), registerBefore(Side, RegistrationStage<?>, RegistryStageDispatchFunction), dispatch(...) @Context singleton wiring Registry instances to stage dispatch functions Modifier<T> / ModifierType<T> ModifierType(boolean skipSelf) skipSelf = true lets children read a parent's SCOPE without the parent applying it to itself ScopeHelper effect(ModifierType<T> effect, Supplier<T> value), get(Reg<?, ?> self, ModifierType<T> effect) Binds a lazily supplied object onto a SCOPE modifier ResourceLocationModifiers ID, id(Function<ResourceLocation, ResourceLocation>), withNamespace(String namespace) Rewrites default "minecraft" namespaces to the mod's namespace CreativeTabModifiers TYPE, set(Supplier<ResourceLocation> tabSupplier) Sets a shared creative tab across a RegistryGroup or Registry ChildrenLookup findParent(Reg<?, ?> start, Class<T> type, BiFunction<Reg<?, ?>, Class<T>, Object> projection) Walks ancestors without resolving cross-registry entries during an active RegisterEvent ChildrenUtils traverse(...), traverseRI(...) Traverses Reg and IChildrenConfiguration / IAdaptedObject hierarchies IModifierConfigure<S> / ConfigureAdapter<S> / IChildrenConfiguration<S> / IAdaptedObject<T> configure(...), addChild(...), getOriginal() Configuration interface and adapter contracts used by codegen

docs.title: 3. Registration Stages and Event Mapping (lib.kasuga.registration.stages)
docs.text:
DefaultRegisterContextDispatchers (common) and DefaultClientRegisterContextDispatchers (@BeanOnlyIn.Client) subscribe NeoForge mod bus listeners in @PostConstruct:

RegistrationStage Constant Payload Type NeoForge Mod Bus Event Side NEW_REGISTRY NewRegistryEvent NewRegistryEvent COMMON REGISTER_EVENT RegisterStageContext RegisterEvent (EventPriority.HIGHEST) COMMON PAYLOAD_REGISTRATION PayloadRegistrationStage RegisterPayloadHandlersEvent COMMON REGISTER_CAPABILITIES CapabilityRegistration RegisterCapabilitiesEvent COMMON CREATIVE_TAB_CONTENT_REGISTRATION CreativeTabContentRegistration BuildCreativeModeTabContentsEvent COMMON MENU_SCREEN_BINDING MenuScreenBindingStage RegisterMenuScreensEvent CLIENT REGISTER_CLIENT_EXTENSIONS FluidClientExtensionsStage RegisterClientExtensionsEvent CLIENT (calls registry.dispatchRegister directly, bypassing registerBefore) BAKING_COMPLETE BakingCompleteStage ModelEvent.BakingCompleted CLIENT COMMON_SETUP RegisterStageContext — Declared on RegistrationStage, currently unsubscribed

Key stage payload methods:

  • RegisterStageContext: register(ResourceKey<? extends Registry<T>>, ResourceLocation, Supplier<T>), getRegistryKey()
  • PayloadRegistrationStage: PayloadRegistrar getRegistrar(String version) (memoized with Util.memoize)
  • CapabilityRegistration: RegisterCapabilitiesEvent getEvent()
  • CreativeTabContentRegistration: getTabKey(), getTab(), getEvent()
  • MenuScreenBindingStage: register(MenuType<T>, Supplier<MenuRendererBuilder<T, U>>)
  • FluidClientExtensionsStage: getEvent(), register(FluidTypeReg<?>)
  • BakingCompleteStage, FMLCommonSetupStageContext, RegistrationStageContext: marker context classes with no payload methods.

docs.title: 4. Minecraft Registrars (lib.kasuga.registration.minecraft)
docs.text: Most classes in this package are generated from modules/core/src/codeTemplate by :modules:generator into lib.kasuga.registration.minecraft.*, along with *Configurations interfaces and *Modifiers classes.

docs.title: 4.1 Base Class: MinecraftDeferRegistryReg and DeferredFillHolder
docs.text:
MinecraftDeferRegistryReg<S extends Reg<S, T>, R, T extends R> is the base class for entries registered into vanilla or NeoForge Registry<R> instances:

  • Before REGISTER_EVENT runs for entryKey, getHolder() returns a DeferredFillHolder<R>.
  • On matching REGISTER_EVENT: calls resolveId() (ResourceLocationModifiers.ID followed by applyProperties(ResourceLocation.class, id)), calls createObject(id), binds DeferredFillHolder, swaps holder to DeferredHolder.create(entryKey, id), posts the entry to the event, and invokes onRegistered(Consumer<? super T>) callbacks.
  • Accessors: getEntry() (throws IllegalStateException before registration), getHolder(), getName(), getRegistryKey(), getResourceLocation().

docs.title: PayloadReg Namespace and Sidedness Guards
docs.text:
• Namespace guard: in ensureEntry(), if the resolved ResourceLocation still has namespace "minecraft" (for instance, when setParent(registry) was omitted), PayloadReg fails fast with IllegalStateException instead of claiming the vanilla namespace (verified by PayloadRegNamespaceTest).
  • Dedicated server protection: if client(...) is supplied and lib.kasuga.inject.class_loader.Envs.isDedicatedServer() is true, PayloadReg installs a no-op lambda instead of evaluating clientHandlerSupplier, preventing client class loading on dedicated servers.

docs.title: Fluid Registration Suite: FluidReg, FluidTypeReg, FluidBlockReg
docs.text:
The 2.0 fluid pipeline targets NeoForge 1.21.1 BaseFlowingFluid:

  • FluidReg<S extends BaseFlowingFluid.Source, F extends BaseFlowingFluid.Flowing>:
  • Constructors: new FluidReg<>(name) (derives <name>_flowing) or new FluidReg<>(typeName, sourceName, flowingName); automatically creates and attaches a child FluidTypeReg.
  • Configuration: instances(sourceFactory, flowingFactory), numericProperties(levelDecrease, slopeDistance, tickRate, explosionResistance), type(t -> ...), block(FluidBlockReg<?>), bucket(String) / bucket(ItemReg<?>).
  • Accessors: getSource(), getFlowing(), getSourceSupplier(), getFlowingSupplier(), getSourceHolder(), getFlowingHolder(), getFluidType(), getFluidTypeHolder().
  • FluidTypeReg<T extends FluidType>:
  • Factories: FluidTypeReg.of(name) / of(name, factory); client visuals: still(path), flowing(path), overlay(path), tint(argb) / tint(r, g, b), fogColor(r, g, b), fog(start, end); fluid properties: density, viscosity, lightLevel, temperature, supportsBoating, sound, bucketSounds, defaultBucketSounds, vaporizeSound.
  • Registers IClientFluidTypeExtensions through REGISTER_CLIENT_EXTENSIONS (RegisterClientExtensionsEvent) so dedicated servers never touch client texture/fog classes.
  • FluidBlockReg<T extends LiquidBlock>:
  • FluidBlockReg.of(name, fluid -> props -> ...), supporting BlockBehaviour.Properties fluent modifiers (FluidBlockRegConfigurations).
  • Relies on NeoForge dispatching minecraft:fluid before minecraft:block and resolves the parent FluidReg via ChildrenLookup.findParent.

docs.title: 4.3 Verified Registration Examples
docs.text:
// 1. Block and BlockItem (from BlockRegistryTest)
public static final Registry REGISTRY = KasugaLibRegistry.getRegistryOf(KasugaLib.MODID);

public static final BlockReg<TestBlock> TEST_BLOCK = BlockReg.of("test_block", TestBlock::new)
        .configure(BlockRegModifiers.BlockProperties.of("destroyTime", p -> { p.destroyTime(10); return p; }))
        .configure(BlockRegModifiers.BlockProperties.of("noOcclusion", p -> { p.noOcclusion(); return p; }))
        .withDefaultBlockItem("test_block")
        .setParent(REGISTRY);

// 2. Fluid, LiquidBlock, and Bucket (from AllFluidTestEntries)
public static final FluidReg<BaseFlowingFluid.Source, BaseFlowingFluid.Flowing> TEST_FLUID =
        new FluidReg<BaseFlowingFluid.Source, BaseFlowingFluid.Flowing>("test_fluid")
                .instances(BaseFlowingFluid.Source::new, BaseFlowingFluid.Flowing::new)
                .numericProperties(2, 4, 10, 100.0F)
                .type(t -> t.viscosity(1200).density(1400).defaultBucketSounds()
                        .tint(0xFF3FA7D6).still("block/test_fluid_still").flowing("block/test_fluid_flow"))
                .block(FluidBlockReg.of("test_fluid_block", fluid -> props -> new LiquidBlock(fluid, props)))
                .bucket("test_fluid_bucket")
                .setParent(REGISTRY);

// 3. Network Payload (from PayloadRegistryTest)
public static final PayloadReg<TestMyClass> TEST_PAYLOAD = new PayloadReg<>("test_payload", TestMyClass.CODEC)
        .stage(PayloadStage.COMMON)
        .client(() -> (msg, ctx) -> {})
        .server(() -> (msg, ctx) -> {})
        .setParent(REGISTRY);

docs.title: 5. Sided Rendering Registry, Kasuga Registrars, and FactoryRegistry
5.1 RenderingRegistry (lib.kasuga.registration.beans.rendering)
docs.text:
RenderingRegistry provides side-polymorphic renderer binding:

  • DefaultRenderingRegistry (@Singleton): server fallback that logs a debug message and ignores registration calls.
  • ClientRenderingRegistry (@Singleton, @Replaces(DefaultRenderingRegistry.class), @BeanOnlyIn.Client, implements RenderingRegistry, Configurable): registers with BlockEntityRenderers, EntityRenderers, and DocumentItemRenderer, and exposes the client config option ignore_block_entity_renderer (default false).

docs.title: 5.2 Kasuga Custom Registrars (lib.kasuga.registration.kasuga)

docs.title: Core Runtime Infrastructure and Content Subsystems (modules/core)
docs.text:
This reference covers the runtime infrastructure and content subsystems in modules/core outside the resource platform, VFS, and registration tree:

  • Networking RPC: lib.kasuga.core.networking.rpc.*
  • Custom saved data and external item storage: lib.kasuga.core.saved.*
  • Optional mod compatibility probing: lib.kasuga.core.compat.*
  • Codecs and lifecycle holders: lib.kasuga.core.codec.*, lib.kasuga.core.holder.*
  • Core rendering and GLSL import hooks: lib.kasuga.core.rendering.*
  • Early loading and client update hooks: lib.kasuga.early.*, lib.kasuga.client.*
  • Content subsystems: lib.kasuga.content.{block,device,document,graph,qr}.*

Related pages: Unified Resource Platform and Script Tickets, Virtual file systems, and Core Mod Entry and Registration System.

docs.title: 1. Networking RPC (lib.kasuga.core.networking.rpc)
docs.text: RpcApi builds fire-and-forget and request-response (CompletableFuture) networking endpoints on top of PayloadReg. Code generation expands the Rpc template in codeTemplate into lib.kasuga.core.networking.rpc.Rpc supporting 0–10 typed arguments.

docs.title: 1.1 RpcApi and One-Way WithOutResponse
docs.text: Type / Method Signature and Behavior new RpcApi<>(String name) Creates an underlying PayloadReg<>("rpc/" + name + "/request", ...) executeOnServer() / executeOnClient() Registers the receiving handler and marks that side executable runOnMainThread() Wraps handler execution in context.enqueueWork(...) before invoking handle(...) register(Reg<?, ?> parent) Attaches underlying payload registration(s) to a parent tree providing a non-"minecraft" namespace call(T request) / call(T request, Player player) Sends via PacketDistributor.sendToPlayer(...) when player instanceof ServerPlayer (requires executeOnClient()) or PacketDistributor.sendToServer(...) otherwise (requires executeOnServer()), throwing IllegalStateException on direction mismatch WithOutResponse.call(T request, Player p) Fire-and-forget wrapper; receivers override handleInstant(T, IPayloadContext)

docs.title: 1.2 Request-Response RpcApi.WithResponse<T, R, S>
docs.text:
WithResponse registers three payloads: rpc/<name>/request, rpc/<name>/response, and rpc/<name>/error (Error carries a UTF-8 string message).

API Behavior and Constraints CompletableFuture<R> run(T request) / run(T request, Player player) Allocates a unique VAR_LONG session ID (bound to accepts = player), sends the request, and returns a CompletableFuture<R> handleInstant(T request, IPayloadContext context) / CompletableFuture<R> handle(T, IPayloadContext) Override one on the receiver; both result and error replies hop onto the main thread via context.enqueueWork(() -> context.reply(...)) setTimeout(Duration) / setTimeoutSeconds(long) / setTimeoutMillis(long) Default timeout is 30 seconds; setTimeout(null) resets to 30 seconds; setTimeout(long) is @Deprecated void tick() Drains sessionManager.checkTimeout(), failing expired futures with RpcTimeoutException. Callers must invoke tick() periodically on the client or server tick so unanswered sessions time out

docs.title: 1.3 Session Management and Generated Rpc Facade
docs.text:
• RpcSessionManager<T>: manages AtomicLong session IDs, a deadline-ordered PriorityQueue<Session<T>>, and a HashMap<Long, Session<T>>. Uses saturatedAdd to clamp extreme timeouts at Long.MAX_VALUE, completes futures outside the internal lock to avoid callback re-entrancy deadlocks, and checks accepts player identity (null accepts any player).
  • IdentifiedRpcPacketType<T>: pairs a VAR_LONG session ID with a StreamCodec<? super FriendlyByteBuf, T> into a CustomPacketPayload.
  • RpcTimeoutException: extends Exception; supplied as the cause when a session expires.
  • Rpc (generated facade):
  • Rpc.wrap(name, func, c1..cn) -> returns RpcV0 .. RpcV10<T1..Tn> (WithOutResponse, call(Player, T1..Tn)).
  • Rpc.wrap(name, func, responseCodec, c1..cn) -> returns RpcR0<R> .. RpcR10<R, T1..Tn> (WithResponse, call(Player, T1..Tn) returns CompletableFuture<R>).
// From TestMyRpc (client calling server with an Integer result)
public static final Rpc.RpcR1<Integer, Integer> MY_RPC = Rpc.wrap(
        "test_rpc_with_response",
        (ctx, i1) -> 42,
        ByteBufCodecs.VAR_INT,
        ByteBufCodecs.VAR_INT
).executeOnServer().runOnMainThread().setTimeoutSeconds(10).register(registry);

// Caller side:
CompletableFuture<Integer> future = MY_RPC.call(null, 41);
// Periodic timeout drain:
MY_RPC.tick();

docs.title: 2. Custom Saved Data and External Save Items (lib.kasuga.core.saved)
docs.text:
For per-dimension vanilla SavedData injection, see Saved<T> in Inject Dependency Injection and Environment Wiring. This package handles world-root-scoped custom files and UUID-linked item storage.

Type Scope and Key APIs SavedSystem @Context singleton registering persistent, network-synchronized data component ITEM_SAVE_ID (kasuga_lib:item_external_id, UUID) on KasugaLibApplication.REGISTRY CustomSavedData Base class with no-arg constructor and save(Path path, HolderLookup.Provider provider) CustomSavedDataManager @Singleton listening on forgeEventBus for ServerStartingEvent (HIGHEST), LevelEvent.Save (LOWEST), and ServerStoppingEvent (LOWEST). Resolves the world root directory via MinecraftServerAccess and caches one instance per subclass via get(Class<T>, SimpleFactory<T>) / get(Class<T>, Factory<T>) ScopedNbtSavedData<T extends SavedData> Extends CustomSavedData; manages keyed .nbt files under <worldDir>/<basePath>/ through DimensionDataStorage. Provides get(key), computeIfAbsent(key), remove(key) (queues disk deletion in pendingRemove for the next save), and getAllSavedNames() ExternalSaveItem Extends Item: assigns a unique ITEM_SAVE_ID via initialize(ItemStack, Consumer<UUID>) or initializeOutputs(ItemStack, LivingEntity, Consumer<UUID>), and reads it via getSaveId(ItemStack) NbtDataStorage<T extends SavedData> Skeleton class holding cache, directory, and provider fields

docs.title: 3. Optional Mod Compatibility Probing (lib.kasuga.core.compat)
docs.text:
CompatCapability<T> provides a lazy, double-checked-locking probe for optional integrations (such as Iris/Sodium ABI probing and OIT fallback in modules/iris-compat):

API Description new CompatCapability<>(String name, Probe<T> probe) Probe.run() may throw ReflectiveOperationException boolean isAvailable() / Result<T> result() Runs the probe once on first access and caches Result<T>(boolean available, T value, String reason, Throwable cause) CompatCapability.requireClass(String className, ClassLoader loader) Calls Class.forName(className, false, loader) without running static initializers CompatCapability.requireMethod(Class<?> owner, String methodName, Class<?> returnType, Class<?>... parameterTypes) Looks up a public method and asserts method.getReturnType() == returnType to detect signature drift

Failure boundary (verified by CompatCapabilityTest): ReflectiveOperationException, InaccessibleObjectException, LinkageError, SecurityException, and a null probe return produce available == false; application bugs such as IllegalStateException propagate rather than being swallowed.

CompatCapability<Method> api = new CompatCapability<>("iris_state", () ->
        CompatCapability.requireMethod(CapturedRenderingState.class, "getCurrentRenderedEntity", int.class));
if (api.isAvailable()) {
    // Safe to use api.result().value()
}

docs.title: 4.1 KasugaCodec
docs.text:
KasugaCodec.mapFunc builds a StreamCodec<B, M> for maps where each key dynamically selects its value codec (used by DocumentComponentRegistries.DOCUMENT_COMPONENT_BYTE_BUF):

public static <B extends ByteBuf, K, V, M extends Map<K, ? extends V>> StreamCodec<B, M> mapFunc(
        IntFunction<? extends M> factory,
        StreamCodec<? super B, K> keyCodec,
        Function<K, StreamCodec<? super B, ? extends V>> valueCodecFunction,
        int maxSize,
        boolean cacheValueCodecByKey
)

docs.title: 4.2 Holder<T> and Provider<T>
docs.text:
Lightweight ref-counted attachment primitives (Simple implementations are not thread-safe):

  • Provider.simple(Supplier<T> creator, Consumer<T> disposer): creates the instance on the first hold, invokes disposer when the last Holder calls release or on dispose(), and exposes getValue() and ifPresent(Consumer<T>).
  • Holder.simple(Consumer<T> applier, Consumer<T> disposer): attach(Provider<T>) detaches any previous provider, holds the value, and runs applier; detach() runs disposer and releases the hold.

docs.title: 5. Core Rendering and GLSL Import Hooks (lib.kasuga.core.rendering)
docs.text: Type Mixin / Hook Mechanism Public API and Behavior ShaderFunctionImport MixinGlslPreprocessor redirects GlslPreprocessor#processImports Maps kasuga_lib:<path> imports to assets/kasuga_lib/shaders/<path>; ShaderFunctionImport.read(Reader) strips leading in/out/uniform declarations and stops before void main(, allowing standalone transform shaders to be #moj_imported as helpers. Setting -Dkasuga.debugShaderImports=true dumps output to ksg_debug/ SpecialRenderingRegistry, ISpecialRenderingItem, ISpecialItemRenderer MixinItemInHandRenderer hooks renderArmWithItem and evaluateWhichHandsToRender Items implementing ISpecialRenderingItem can override getRenderPriority(...) for hand selection and register first-person renderers via SpecialRenderingRegistry.register(item, renderer) (wrapped in pushPose/popPose) IBlurControl MixinScreen applied to vanilla Screen ksgB$isBlurEnabled() / ksg$SetBlurEnabled(boolean) toggles vanilla screen background blur per screen BufferBuilderSupplier Functional interface @Nullable BufferBuilder init(ByteBufferBuilder buffer, VertexFormat.Mode mode, VertexFormat format)

docs.title: 6.1 ModLoadingManager and ModLoadingProgress
docs.text:
ModLoadingManager.createTask(String label, int steps) picks the highest-priority available ModLoadingProgressProvider:

  1. ModLoadingProgressProvider.FML (priority 255): reflectively binds NeoForge StartupNotificationManager.prependProgressBar and ProgressMeter, returning NeoForgeFmlEarlyDisplayProgress.
  2. ModLoadingProgressProvider.DEFAULT (priority -1000): falls back to DefaultModLoadingProgress, logging "<label> [<n>/<totalSteps>]" via SLF4J.

ModLoadingProgress methods: increment(), complete(), set(int), steps(), and label(String).

docs.title: 6.2 LoadingIndicator (lib.kasuga.client.loading)
docs.text:
Thread-safe AtomicReference<Snapshot> progress holder rendered onto Minecraft's LoadingOverlay#render by MixinLoadingOverlay (used by KasugaModelManager and CombinedTextureManager during model and PBR atlas reloads):

  • LoadingIndicator.begin(String label, int total)
  • LoadingIndicator.update(String label, int current, int total)
  • LoadingIndicator.label(String label)
  • LoadingIndicator.complete()
  • LoadingIndicator.snapshot() -> returns Snapshot(boolean active, String label, int current, int total) with progress() clamped to [0.0f, 1.0f].

docs.title: 6.3 ClientBlockUpdateHooks (lib.kasuga.client)
docs.text:
Hooked into the tail of ClientLevel#sendBlockUpdated by MixinClientLevel, broadcasting world-visible single-block updates on the client main thread:

  • AutoCloseable addListener(Consumer<Update> listener): returns a removal handle; listeners must stay lightweight.
  • Update record: record Update(ClientLevel level, long packedPos, BlockState oldState, BlockState newState).

docs.title: 7.1 UnModeledBlockProperty (lib.kasuga.content.block)
docs.text:
UnModeledBlockProperty<J extends Comparable<J>, T extends Property<J>> extends Property<J> (factory UnModeledBlockProperty.create(T prop)) attaches logical blockstate properties that are excluded from vanilla blockstate JSON model lookups and NBT deserialization:

  • MixinBlockModelShaper overwrites statePropertiesToString to skip UnModeledBlockProperty instances.
  • MixinNbtUtils returns null during NbtUtils#readBlockState when looking up an UnModeledBlockProperty.

docs.title: 7.2 Global Device Management and Attribute Indexing (lib.kasuga.content.device)
docs.text: Type Responsibility and Key APIs DeviceRegistries Creates two synced registries: kasuga_lib:device_attribute_type (DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE) and kasuga_lib:device_type (DEVICE) Device / DeviceType<T> Base logical device with dirty tracking (setDirty, isDirty, cleanDirty), save(CompoundTag), load(CompoundTag), and acceptMerge(Device) DeviceAttribute / DeviceAttributeType<T> Attribute base and record DeviceAttributeType<T>(factory, isUnique, canIndex, persistent) built via DeviceAttributeType.Builder AttributeIndex Maintains unique primary index primaryIndex (isUnique) and multi-value indexable map (canIndex), exposing reindex, notifyAttributeAdded, notifyAttributeRemoved, and queryAttribute(DeviceAttribute) GlobalDeviceManager @Context singleton persisting devices and attributes to <worldDir>/devices/<uuid>.nbt via CustomSavedDataManager and GlobalDeviceSavedData.Customized; provides addAttribute, removeAttribute, getAttributes, remove, merge, and saveToData

docs.title: 7.3 Document Items and Components (lib.kasuga.content.document)
docs.text: Type Responsibility and Key APIs DocumentComponentRegistries @Context singleton registering kasuga_lib:document_component_type (DOCUMENT_COMPONENT_REGISTRY) and item data component kasuga_lib:document_components (DOCUMENT_COMPONENT, using Codec.dispatchedMap and KasugaCodec.mapFunc) DocumentComponentType<T> Abstract component type defining codec(), networkCodec(), convert(Object), convertBack(T), and readable() DocumentItem Extends Item and implements ISpecialRenderingItem (priority 2); drops max stack size to 1 whenever DOCUMENT_COMPONENT is non-empty DocumentItemRenderer / DocumentComponentRenderer<T> Implements ISpecialItemRenderer (one-hand and two-hand rendering); binds component renderers via registerComponentRenderer(DocumentComponentType<T>, DocumentComponentRenderer<T>) (usually via DocumentComponentRendererReg and RenderingRegistry) DocumentComponentNode Empty placeholder class

docs.title: 7.4 Dynamic Connected Graphs and Cycle Detection (lib.kasuga.content.graph)
docs.text:
• GraphManager<K, V, E> (backed by org.jgrapht:jgrapht-core:1.5.2): maintains connected-component graphs (HashMap<K, Graph<V, E>>) where subclasses implement createGraph() and createKey().
  • Provides createNode, removeNode, addConnection, removeConnection, synchronizeNode(vertex, connectionsSupplier), getGraphIdByNode, and getGraphByNode.
  • Cross-component addConnection merges graphs; removeNode and removeConnection invoke GraphAlgo.split(...) (ConnectivityInspector) to split disconnected components (note that propagateSplit calls newGraphs.pop(), assuming at least one component remains—removing the sole vertex of a 1-node graph will throw NoSuchElementException).
  • GraphCycleDetector<T> (pure JDK collections, zero Minecraft dependencies):
  • GraphCycleDetector.dfs(Set<T> nodes, GraphAdapter<T> adapter): three-color DFS detecting all directed cycles, returning CycleResult<T> (getCycles(), getNodesInCycles(), hasCycle()).
  • GraphCycleDetector.topologicalSort(Set<T> nodes, GraphAdapter<T> adapter): Kahn's BFS topological sort (reversing adapter edges so parents appear before children), returning TopoResult<T> (getSorted(), getNodesNotSorted(), hasCycle()).

docs.title: 7.5 QR Code Utilities (lib.kasuga.content.qr)
docs.text:
• QrCodeCache.encodeBitMatrix(String content): encodes a 64 × 64 QR BitMatrix via com.google.zxing:core:3.5.3 (MultiFormatWriter), throwing WriterException on failure.
  • QrCodeTexture extends DynamicTexture: wraps a NativeImage into a dynamic Minecraft texture.

docs.title: Create Module Integration Reference
docs.text:
modules/create provides KasugaLibNext's optional Create 6 integration, covering the track and bogey registration DSL, train device and custom signal segment extensions, bogey and contraption Proxy adapters, extended contraption interaction shapes, and moving-structure scene hosts. All Micronaut beans are gated on @CreateModBeans (IfCreateModLoaded) so they activate only when the create mod is loaded.

Package root: lib.kasuga.create Source tree: modules/create/src/main/java/lib/kasuga/create/

Related guides and scene-host references:

  • Multi-Bogey Train Carriages / Carriage Vertical Posture
  • Model Collision, Chunk Lifecycle, and Distant Rendering (Create contraption LOD)
  • Scenes and UI on moving structures / Aeronautics / Sable scene hosts
  • Integrating Content With the Proxy Kernel / Proxy: An Adapter Between Minecraft Elements and Animation

docs.title: 1. Create Registration DSL and Lifecycle
docs.text: Packages: lib.kasuga.create.registration, lib.kasuga.create.registration.{bogey,track,edge_data,edge_point}, lib.kasuga.create.client.registration

docs.title: 1.1 Dispatching and Two-Phase Commit
docs.text:
CreateRegistrationDispatcher (@Context @CreateModBeans) hooks RegisterContextRegistry.registerBefore(Side.COMMON, RegistrationStage.REGISTER_EVENT, ...) so CreateRegistrationState.prepare(registry, clientBridge) runs once before the vanilla registration event:

Type Responsibility Key members CreateRegistrationDispatcher Wires CreateRegistrationStages.PREPARE into the common registration lifecycle @PostConstruct init() CreateRegistrationStages Defines the Create preparation stage PREPARE (RegistrationStage<CreateRegistrationEvent>) CreateRegistrationState Tracks per-Registry preparation state so commit runs at most once Status (NEW / PREPARING / COMMITTED / FAILED), prepare(...), status(), preparationCount() CreateRegistrationEvent Collects, validates, and commits Create entries in phase order Phase (TRACK_MATERIAL, BOGEY_SIZE, BOGEY_BLOCK, BOGEY_STYLE), submit(...), contains(...) CreateClientBridge Isolates client visual wiring; dedicated servers fall back to CreateClientBridge.noop() Implemented on client by ClientCreateRegistrationBridge (@BeanOnlyIn.Client)

CreateRegistrationEvent guarantees:

  • All submissions are sorted by (Phase, ResourceLocation.toString()); duplicate (Phase, id) keys throw IllegalStateException;
  • Every validator runs before any committer executes;
  • Any validation or commit exception transitions CreateRegistrationState to FAILED and caches the failure so subsequent calls rethrow the same exception.

docs.title: 1.2 Bogey Registration: BogeySizeReg, BogeyBlockReg, BogeyGroupReg
docs.text:
Registration / Index Package Signatures & Behavior BogeySizeReg registration.bogey BogeySizeReg(String name) (default radius 1.0f), BogeySizeReg(String name, float wheelRadius), size(float wheelRadius). Radius must be finite and positive. Commits via BogeySizes.register(...) and populates BogeyMetadataIndex. BogeyBlockReg<T extends AbstractBogeyBlock<?>> registration.bogey BogeyBlockReg(String name, BogeySizeReg size, BogeyBlockFactory<T> factory). Owns a child BlockReg<T> (getBlockReg()) and exposes withBlockProperties(UnaryOperator<BlockBehaviour.Properties>) and getSizeReg(). Validates during PREPARE that size is committed or pending in the same event. BogeyGroupReg registration.bogey BogeyGroupReg(String name, String cycleGroup), producing a Create BogeyStyle. Requires at least one size, rejects duplicate style IDs already in AllBogeyStyles.BOGEY_STYLES, checks size/block consistency, and calls clientBridge.validateBogeyRenderer(...). BogeyRendererHandle registration.bogey record BogeyRendererHandle(ResourceLocation id), BogeyRendererHandle.of(ResourceLocation). Keeps common code decoupled from client renderer types. ClientBogeyRendererRegistry client.registration @Context @CreateModBeans @BeanOnlyIn.Client. register(BogeyRendererHandle, Supplier<? extends BogeyRenderer>, BogeyVisualizer), get(...), remove(...), clear() backed by WeakHashMap. BogeyMetadataIndex registration.bogey SizeMetadata(ResourceLocation id, float wheelRadius), StyleMetadata(ResourceLocation id, ResourceLocation cycleGroup), get(BogeySizes.BogeySize) / get(BogeyStyle) / clear() (WeakHashMap).

Fluent methods on BogeyGroupReg:

  • displayName(Component) / translationKey(String)
  • sound(Supplier<SoundEvent>), contactParticle(ParticleOptions), smokeParticle(ParticleOptions), defaultData(CompoundTag)
  • bogey(BogeySizeReg size, BogeyBlockReg<?> block, BogeyRendererHandle rendererHandle)
  • onCommitted(Consumer<BogeyStyle> callback): runs once after the style is committed into AllBogeyStyles. Style IDs and sizes only exist at this point, so external render-pipeline mappings such as BogeyModels.register(...) must be called inside onCommitted.

docs.title: 1.3 Track Registration: TrackMaterialReg and TrackReg
docs.text:
Registration / Index Package Signatures & Behavior TrackMaterialReg registration.track TrackMaterialReg(String name) builds Create's TrackMaterial and records TrackMaterialMetadata in TrackMaterialMetadataIndex. TrackReg<T extends TrackBlock> registration.track TrackReg(String name, TrackMaterialReg material, TrackBlockFactory<T> factory). Composes child BlockReg<T> (getBlockReg()) and ItemReg<TrackBlockItem> (getItemReg() / getItem()) without inheriting BlockReg. Hooks CreateClientBridge.trackBlockCreated to wrap baked block models in Create's TrackModel. Exposes withBlockProperties(...), withItemProperties(...), and getMaterialReg(). TrackModelDescriptor registration.track Mode (DEFAULT / STANDARD / CUSTOM), defaultModels(), standardModels(), custom(tie, leftSegment, rightSegment). TrackMaterialMetadata / TrackMaterialMetadataIndex registration.track TrackMaterialMetadata(ResourceLocation id, boolean replaceable, UnaryOperator<Vec3> railOffset); put / get / remove / clear (WeakHashMap). ClientTrackMetadataIndex client.registration @Context @CreateModBeans @BeanOnlyIn.Client, caches TrackModelDescriptor per TrackMaterial.

Fluent methods on TrackMaterialReg:

  • Required: block(Supplier<? extends TrackBlock>) / block(TrackReg<?>) and particle(ResourceLocation);
  • Optional: lang(String), trackType(TrackMaterial.TrackType) / trackType(ResourceLocation, TrackMaterial.TrackType.TrackBlockFactory), sleeper(ItemLike...), rails(ItemLike...), replaceable(boolean);
  • Models: defaultModels(), standardModels(), customModels(ResourceLocation tie, ResourceLocation leftSegment, ResourceLocation rightSegment);
  • Curve rail gauge offset: simpleTrackModelOffset(float halfDistance) (vector -> vector.scale(halfDistance)) or trackModelOffset(UnaryOperator<Vec3>), defaulting to vector -> vector.scale(.965f). On the client, CreateMixinPlugin selects BezierConnectionMixin or ModernBezierSegmentsMixin / ModernBezierGirdersMixin according to Create's curve API.

docs.title: 1.4 Edge Data & Edge Point Registrations: EdgeDataReg and TrackEdgePointReg
docs.text:
• EdgeDataReg<T extends EdgeExtraPayload> (lib.kasuga.create.registration.edge_data): new EdgeDataReg<>(registrationKey, supplier, reader) builds an EdgeExtraPayloadType<T> and registers it into EdgeExtraPayloadRegistry during RegistrationStage.REGISTER_EVENT.
  • TrackEdgePointReg<T extends TrackEdgePoint> (lib.kasuga.create.registration.edge_point): new TrackEdgePointReg<>(id, supplier) calls EdgePointType.register(...) during RegistrationStage.REGISTER_EVENT; getBlockItemFactory() provides a BiFunction<Block, Item.Properties, BlockItem> via TrackTargetingBlockItem.ofType.
  • Edge-point helpers (content.train.edge_point and client.rendering.edge_point):
  • BogeyObserverEdgePoint: defines void notifyBogey(Train train). Note that automatic dispatch of BogeyObserverEdgePoint inside TrainMixin's frontSignalListener and backSignalListener is currently commented out in source.
  • EdgePointBlockEntity<T extends TrackEdgePoint>: extends Create's SmartBlockEntity, attaches TrackTargetingBehaviour<T>, and delegates getEdgePointType() to subclasses.
  • EdgePointRenderer, EdgePointBlockEntityRenderer<T>, EdgePointOverlayRenderer, and EdgePointOverlayRendererRegistry (weak-key registry mapping EdgePointType<?> -> EdgePointOverlayRenderer).

docs.title: 1.5 Minimal Registration Example
docs.text:
// Common definitions (adapted from contentTesting)
public static final BogeySizeReg PK209P = new BogeySizeReg("pk209p", 0.915f / 2f);
public static final BogeyRendererHandle PK209P_RENDERER =
        BogeyRendererHandle.of(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath("examplemod", "pk209p_renderer"));

public static final BogeyBlockReg<ExampleBogeyBlock> STANDARD_BOGEY = new BogeyBlockReg<>(
        "pk209p_bogey",
        PK209P,
        (properties, size) -> new ExampleBogeyBlock(properties, size, /* ... */)
).withBlockProperties(properties -> properties.strength(2.0f).noOcclusion());

public static final BogeyGroupReg STANDARD_GROUP = new BogeyGroupReg("standard", "example_bogey")
        .displayName(Component.literal("Standard Bogey"))
        .bogey(PK209P, STANDARD_BOGEY, PK209P_RENDERER)
        .onCommitted(style -> BogeyModels.register(
                style.id, PK209P.getEntry(), pk209pParts, 0.91f + BogeyRoots.CREATE_Y_OFFSET
        ));

public static final TrackMaterialReg STANDARD_MATERIAL = new TrackMaterialReg("standard")
        .lang("Standard")
        .particle(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath("examplemod", "block/track_particle"))
        .customModels(tieModel, leftSegModel, rightSegModel)
        .simpleTrackModelOffset(0.755f);

public static final TrackReg<ExampleTrackBlock> STANDARD_TRACK = new TrackReg<>(
        "standard_track",
        STANDARD_MATERIAL,
        (properties, material) -> new ExampleTrackBlock(properties, material, STANDARD_BOGEY::getEntry)
);

public static void register(Registry registry) {
    PK209P.setParent(registry);
    STANDARD_BOGEY.setParent(registry);
    STANDARD_GROUP.setParent(registry);
    STANDARD_MATERIAL.block(STANDARD_TRACK).setParent(registry);
    STANDARD_TRACK.setParent(registry);
}

// Client renderer binding (@BeanOnlyIn.Client)
renderers.register(
        PK209P_RENDERER,
        ProxyBogeyVisual.NoopRenderer::new,
        (context, partialTick, inContraption) -> new ProxyBogeyVisual(
                context, PK209P.getEntry(), myContraptionBogeyProxy)
);

docs.title: 2. Train Devices, Custom Track Segments, and Graph Extra Data
2.1 TrainDeviceRegistry and TrainDeviceSystem
docs.text:
Package: lib.kasuga.create.content.train.device

TrainMixin implements TrainDeviceProvider, attaching one TrainDeviceManager to each Create Train and forwarding NBT serialization, ticks, speed/distance hooks, and signal callbacks:

Type Key Methods Notes TrainDeviceRegistry register(ResourceLocation, TrainDeviceSystemType<?>), register(ResourceLocation, TrainDeviceSystemType<?>, boolean contextDevice), get(ResourceLocation), getKey(TrainDeviceSystemType<?>), createInitialContextDevices(TrainDeviceManager) Registers train device system types. Setting contextDevice = true instantiates the system on every newly constructed Train. Duplicate IDs or types throw IllegalArgumentException. TrainDeviceSystem write(CompoundTag), read(CompoundTag), earlyTick(Level), tick(Level), initializeServer(Level), beforeSpeed(), cancelSlowdown(), notifySpeed(double), notifyDistance(double), notifySignalFront(...), notifySignalBack(...), notifySignalCollection(), notifyDisassemble(Direction, BlockPos), onSegmentUpdated(ResourceLocation) Base class for per-train systems. On the first non-client tick, invokes initializeServer(Level) once. TrainDeviceManager getManager(Train), getManager(MovementContext), getManager(AbstractContraptionEntity, BlockPos), getSystem(TrainDeviceSystemType<T>), getOrCreateSystem(TrainDeviceSystemType<T>), updateCache() Manages per-train system instances. cancelSlowdown() uses a cached flag updated via updateCache(). Persists under "TrainDeviceSystems". docs.title: 2.2 BoundarySegmentRegistry and CustomTrackSegment
docs.text:
Package: lib.kasuga.create.content.train.signal

Provides custom track-graph signal/circuit segments independent of Create's built-in block signals:

Type Responsibility & Key Methods BoundarySegmentRegistry register(ResourceLocation featureLocation, EdgePointType<? extends CustomBoundary> boundary, Function<UUID, CustomTrackSegment> constructor), registerUpdateListener(ResourceLocation, EdgePointType<? extends SegmentUpdateListener>), createSegment(CustomBoundary, UUID), createSegmentByFeatureName(ResourceLocation, UUID), getFeatureName(...), getBoundaries(). CustomTrackSegment Per-segment state object constructed with UUID segmentId; overridable write(), read(CompoundTag), and onEarlyGlobalTick() (invoked from GlobalRailwayManagerMixin.onTick on Overworld ticks via RailwayData.onEarlyGlobalTick(Level)). docs.title: 3. Bogey Proxy and Train Visual Integration
docs.text:
Packages: lib.kasuga.create.proxy, lib.kasuga.create.client.rendering

KasugaLibNext shares one BogeyModels registry across placed bogey block entities and contraption-mounted train bogeys, driving both through the ProxySession kernel.

flowchart LR
    Placed["AbstractBogeyBlockEntity\n(placed bogey)"] --> BP["BogeyProxy + BogeyRoots"]
    Train["Create BogeyVisual hook"] --> PBV["ProxyBogeyVisual\n(per-frame update / hide / delete)"]
    PBV --> CB["ContraptionBogey\n(HostFrame snapshot)"]
    PBV --> CBT["ContraptionBogeyTickers\n(ClientTickEvent.Post)"]
    CB --> CBP["ContraptionBogeyProxy\n(+ CREATE_ORIGIN_LIFT)"]
    PBV --> Adapter["CreateBogeyProxyAdapter"]
    Adapter --> Kernel["ProxyRuntime.GLOBAL / ProxySession\n+ RigidPartVisualStage"]

docs.title: 3.1 BogeyModels, BogeyRoots, and ContraptionBogeyProxy
docs.text:
• BogeyModels: thread-safe static registry (ConcurrentHashMap) mapping (styleId, sizeId) or style-wide styleId to Placement(List<ModelPart> parts, float yOffset). Resolution order: exact (style, size) → style-wide → null. Also provides styleIdOf(CompoundTag bogeyData) reading Create's "BogeyStyle" NBT tag.
  • BogeyRoots: CREATE_Y_OFFSET = -1.5f - 1f / 128f (Create's bogey models place their origin at the rail plane rather than the block center). BogeyRoots.of(element, yOffset) builds the block-centered transform including AbstractBogeyBlock.AXIS rotation.
  • BogeyProxy<T extends AbstractBogeyBlockEntity>: implements ElementProxy<T> for placed bogeys; override partsFor(T, BogeyModels.Placement) to attach ModelPart.Spin.tick(...) or pull / push for an FSM.
  • ContraptionBogey: train-side host carrier storing an atomic immutable record HostFrame(float wheelAngle, Transform root) snapshot; normalizedRoot() applies placementYOffset exactly once.
  • ContraptionBogeyProxy: implements ElementProxy<ContraptionBogey> for train bogeys.
  • CREATE_ORIGIN_LIFT = -BogeyRoots.CREATE_Y_OFFSET (1.5f + 1f / 128f);
  • rootOf(org.joml.Matrix4f pose, org.joml.Vector3i renderOrigin) converts Flywheel's render-origin-relative PoseStack matrix into world-space placement coordinates by adding renderOrigin and lifting by CREATE_ORIGIN_LIFT;
  • configure(ContraptionBogey) looks up BogeyModels.resolve(element.styleId(), element.sizeId()) and stores element.placementYOffset(...); subclasses override partsFor(...) to attach ModelPart.Spin.frame(...).

docs.title: 3.2 ProxyBogeyVisual, ContraptionBogeyTickers, and CreateBogeyProxyAdapter
docs.text:
• ProxyBogeyVisual implements BogeyVisual:
  • Constructor: new ProxyBogeyVisual(VisualizationContext context, BogeySizes.BogeySize size, ElementProxy<ContraptionBogey> template) (registered in ClientBogeyRendererRegistry).
  • Lazy creation: the first update(CompoundTag bogeyData, float wheelAngle, PoseStack poseStack) resolves the style ID from bogeyData, constructs ContraptionBogey, attaches a session via CreateBogeyProxyAdapter.attach(...), and registers with ContraptionBogeyTickers.
  • Strict tick/frame split: update(...) executes during Flywheel's beginFrame and only calls session.publishFrame(...) (calling resume() if SUSPENDED); logical stepping runs once per game tick in ContraptionBogeyTickers (ClientTickEvent.Post → session.tick(gameTime, 1.0 / 20.0)).
  • Lifecycle & threading: hide() calls session.suspend(); a style change or delete() (which Flywheel may invoke from a worker thread) schedules session.close() onto the client game thread via DeferredGameThreadTask and ContraptionBogeyTickers.
  • ProxyBogeyVisual.NoopRenderer implements BogeyRenderer: register alongside ProxyBogeyVisual in ClientBogeyRendererRegistry so Create's non-Flywheel fallback renderer does not draw a duplicate model.
  • CreateBogeyProxyAdapter:
  • attach(ContraptionBogey element, ElementProxy<ContraptionBogey> template, ProxyIdentity identity, ProxyAttachToken token, @Nullable Level level):
    • Registers a temporary ProxyDefinition under ProxyKey.external("kasuga_lib", "contraption_bogey/" + identity.discriminator() + "/" + token) in ProxyRuntime.GLOBAL and attaches element;
    • Builds a RigidPartVisualStage (plus an optional FsmAnimatedModel via ProxyConfig.machine() wrapped in ProxyMachineController) using LogicalStepPolicy.fixed(1.0 / 20.0, 5);
    • Forwards isReady / bind / tick / publishFrame / suspend / resume / rebind / close to RigidPartVisualStage;
    • Guarantees single-shot template.onDetach(element) and definition unregistration on close() and on every attach/configure failure path.

docs.title: 4. Contraption-Captured Proxy Models and Interaction Shapes
docs.text: Packages: lib.kasuga.create.client.rendering, lib.kasuga.create.interaction, lib.kasuga.create.mixins.client

docs.title: 4.1 ContraptionProxyModels
docs.text:
@Context @CreateModBeans @BeanOnlyIn.Client. Captured ProxyModelBlockEntity instances inside Contraption.presentBlockEntities have no world BlockEntityTicker or vanilla block entity renderer. ContraptionProxyModels drives their existing ProxySessions on the client:

  • On ClientTickEvent.Post, scans AbstractContraptionEntity instances and creates an Attachment (backed by CreateSceneHosts.contraption(entity)) when presentBlockEntities contains any ProxyModelBlockEntity.
  • Calls refreshState(model, contraption.getBlocks().get(localPos)) each tick to apply Create packet BlockState updates without detaching the session or advancing the animation clock.
  • Calls model.bindVisualHost(instanceIdentity(entity.getUUID(), localPos), anchorTransform(pose, localPos)), assigning stable identity kasuga_lib:contraption_model/<entityUuid>/<x>/<y>/<z> and host-local world anchor pose.
  • Forwards contraption.isHiddenInPortal(localPos) to session.suspend() / resume(), and otherwise ticks the model via ProxyTickers.tickClientBlockEntity(model).
  • On RenderFrameEvent.Pre (EventPriority.HIGHEST, before shared model sampling), refreshes anchorTransform and calls session.publishFrame(null).
  • Calls model.releaseVisualHost() on EntityLeaveLevelEvent, contraption replacement, local block removal, or level change.

docs.title: 4.2 ContraptionShapeProvider, ContraptionBlockView, and ContraptionInteractionShapes
docs.text:
Provides opt-in contraption-local BlockGetter ownership context and extended raycast picking for blocks whose selection shape extends outside their anchor cell:

Type Package Notes ContraptionShapeProvider interaction Opt-in Block interface: VoxelShape getContraptionShape(BlockState state, BlockGetter localBlocks, BlockPos localPos). ContraptionBlockView interaction Read-only BlockGetter backed by Contraption.getBlocks() and contraption.presentBlockEntities: returns Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState() for unoccupied coordinates and null from getBlockEntity when absent from getBlocks(); never falls through to the outer world; delegates height bounds to dimensions. ContraptionInteractionShapes interaction shape(...) passes ContraptionBlockView to ContraptionShapeProvider blocks while leaving ordinary blocks on the original query; pick(...) scans non-portal-hidden ContraptionShapeProvider blocks across contraption.getBlocks() to pick extended shapes while preserving the closest ordinary native hit. ContraptionInteractionShapeMixin mixins.client Mixin on ContraptionHandlerClient#rayTraceContraption wrapping BlockState.getShape and injecting at RETURN for extended selection picking.
